metadata.title: Nvidia Is the Only Reason the S&P 500 Is Up. No, Really.

content.text:
LIVE
Last Updated:
2 min ago
Nvidia lived up to its billing.
Shares of the AI chip titan buoyed the S&P 500 on an otherwise mixed day. Only 161 S&P 500 stocks were rising, with the index up 0.3%.
The S&P 500 was recently up about $158.5 billion in market cap, at the same time Nvidia was up $334.4 billion. In other words, the S&P 500 would be down $175.9 billion in market value, if not for Nvidia.
